author: Julianna Salinas
title: David and Victoria Beckham worried son Brooklyn will end up broke after signing prenup - NewsBreak
text:
By Julianna Salinas ,
1 hours ago David and Victoria Beckham are reportedly worried about their son, Brooklyn , after he publicly aired their ongoing family feud on social media.
According to a source who spoke to The Sun, the famous couple 'have fears their son Brooklyn will be left with nothing' after he signed an iron-clad prenup before marrying his wife, Nicola Peltz-Beckham, whose father Nelson Peltz is a billionaire businessman.
On January 19, the 26-year-old penned a series of explosive Instagram Stories that detailed why he is estranged from his footballer dad and pop star mother, with claims that his parents have been 'trying endlessly to ruin' his relationship .
• Cruz Beckham breaks silence after brother Brooklyn's bombshell family allegations
• 'Tone deaf' Ivanka Trump slammed as she jumps on viral trend amid ICE protests
The couple married in 2022, when Brooklyn chose to sign a prenuptial agreement outlining that he would not gain any of the Peltz family fortune if he and the 31-year-old actress were to split up. If they were to divorce, he would walk away with "half of what they have made as a brand."
The insider explained, "The fear is that he has been completely absorbed into the Peltz's and has become alienated from everyone else. If they ever did break up, Brooklyn would be completely ostracized and without much cash to show for it."
"It’s as if he’s being held captive or something, because heartbreakingly, that’s what it feels like for them. His future is completely in the hands of the Peltz's," the source went on to say.
While that may be the case, it's unlikely the nepo baby would end up penniless, as David and Victoria Beckham are estimated to be worth £335 million ($450 million).
The Sun noted that those close to the aspiring chef say the prenup is "irrelevant" as he and Nicola are "stronger than ever as a couple."
In his rant exposing the drama between him and his parents, Brooklyn revealed, "Weeks before our big day, my parents repeatedly pressured and attempted to bribe me into signing away the rights to my name, which would have affected me, my wife, and our future children."
He continued, "They were adamant on my signing before my wedding date because then the terms of the deal would be initiated. My holdout affected the payday, and they have never treated me the same since. "
Brooklyn, who is the eldest of David and Victoria's three children, says that he has no wish to reconcile with his family, especially since his parents have supposedly "been trying endlessly to ruin my relationship since before my wedding, and it hasn't stopped."
